description: Sydney and Nigel's final run moves through pirate treasure, Arthurian relics, ancient weapons and legendary objects such as Pandora's Box and the Fountain of Youth, while several cases pull Sydney's own past and Nigel's family directly into the hunt.

s03e01.description: A rival beats Sydney and Nigel to the map leading to the explosive Dragon's Egg, setting off a race for the ancient Chinese weapon.

s03e02.description: Sydney's holiday with an old flame in Singapore is interrupted by a new hunt for Parvati's Bowl, a relic she cannot resist chasing.

s03e03.description: A childhood friend brings Sydney back to the unsolved shooting of a beloved teacher and the Egyptian pendant at the center of the crime.

s03e04.description: A student prince abandons class to seek a legendary Arabian artifact said to expose lies and reveal traitors.

s03e05.description: Sydney follows a trail to buried pirate treasure, where betrayal proves as dangerous as the terrain.

s03e06.description: A royal death and a missing legendary jewel draw Sydney into the mystery of the Star of Nadir.

s03e07.description: A novelist recruits Sydney to find a relic associated with Vlad Tepes, reviving an old trail of occult violence in Eastern Europe.

s03e08.description: An underground Aztec burial chamber yields a mysterious object instead of a body, and the discovery brings an ancient danger back into the open.

s03e09.description: While retrieving a strength-giving lancet in New Guinea, Sydney and Nigel encounter a dead man who looks exactly like Nigel.

s03e10.description: A collector uses an ancient necklace capable of enslaving its wearer to force Sydney into helping raise a lost statue of Athena.

s03e11.description: A Salem-era amulet surfaces in a college dorm, drawing Sydney into a relic whose history is tangled with witch trials and ritual magic.

s03e12.description: Sydney reaches a Southeast Asian temple containing an idol of Ganesha only to become trapped inside while rebels close in.

s03e13.description: Evidence of a mysterious catastrophe six centuries earlier leads Sydney to investigate a Pacific Northwest legend of lights descending from the sky.

s03e14.description: Sydney races bombing raids to recover an urn believed to contain the remains of Confucius before an entire Cambodian province is destroyed.

s03e15.description: The murder of Sydney's professor friend in Istanbul points toward his search for Hippolyta's Belt and his attempt to prove Hercules had a historical basis.

s03e16.description: An ancient mummy discovered at an Arctic base lures Sydney and a reluctant Nigel into a frozen archaeological mystery.

s03e17.description: Scotland Yard asks Sydney and Nigel to identify a fifth-century murder weapon that may actually be the burial cross of King Arthur.

s03e18.description: Sydney and Nigel follow the trail of the Spanish crown hidden from Napoleon's army by King Carlos IV.

s03e19.description: A key inherited from a legendary predecessor sends Sydney after the one relic he never managed to find: Pandora's Box.

s03e20.description: A cave painting may reveal the resting place of warrior princess Kahina's saddle, drawing Sydney and Nigel into the legacy of a ruler who fought for her throne.

s03e21.description: With Nigel away, Sydney joins his brother Preston in England to search for a bottle said to contain water from the Fountain of Youth.

s03e22.description: A Celtic historian brings Sydney and Nigel a lead to the astronomicons, the lost Druid keys to Stonehenge.
